answer: Each close, 36% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. A farm cannot pre-compute those re-asks, as the sample is drawn from the cipher beacon after the epoch ends and the vertex nonce differs from the first. Since the delta audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
